mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < -2% and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 70% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.25% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 0.25% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 300,000 and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) both increase by more than 5% YoY, it signals a broad-based demand expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If both HOUST YoY > 5% and RSAFS YoY > 5%, and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) combined with an increase in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY < 0% and UNRATE > previous month
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < 0% and UNRATE > previous month, and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
